instruction: Enable the minimal view mode in VLC player. I prefer a cleaner interface without the full controls.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling VLC minimal view mode (qt-minimal-view=1). Uses existing check_qt_minimal_view metric function and get_vlc_config getter. The evaluator reads vlcrc config file and checks if qt-minimal-view is set to 1. Similar complexity to original task - changing a single VLC configuration setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses get_vlc_config getter to read VLC configuration file (vlcrc) from OS-specific path
Metric function check_qt_minimal_view correctly reads and parses the qt-minimal-view setting from config file
Expected value handling is correct: metric receives rules dict directly and accesses expected_qt_minimal_view correctly
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config changes are written to disk
Complete verification coverage: instruction requires enabling minimal view mode, evaluator checks qt-minimal-view=1 which is the correct config setting
Expected value is semantically correct: qt-minimal-view=1 means minimal view mode is enabled
No edge case issues: metric handles missing config key by defaulting to '0' (disabled state)
